errors.lineBilled: This line has already been invoiced: to change its terms, create a new version from a given date.
errors.milestonesStarted: This contract has already started invoicing its milestones: new work goes in another contract.
errors.milestoneBilled: This milestone has already been invoiced: it can't be deleted, and its percentage and order can't change.
errors.milestonesTotal: Milestones must add up to exactly 100%.
errors.milestoneOrder: The earlier milestones have to be invoiced first.
errors.milestoneAlreadyBilled: This milestone has already been invoiced.
errors.noOneOffLines: The contract has no one-off lines to split into milestones.
errors.vatRateRequired: Choose a VAT rate for the line.
errors.pauseRecurringOnly: Only monthly or yearly lines can be paused.
errors.versionDateInvalid: The new version must start after what has already been invoiced and within the line's term.
errors.versionNotRecurring: A one-off line has no versions.
errors.contractBilled: This contract has already generated invoices: its signature can't be removed.
errors.contractNotSigned: The contract isn't signed yet: sign it to be able to invoice it.
errors.noIssuer: The contract has no issuer assigned.
errors.invoiceImmutable: An issued invoice can't be modified: it's fixed with a corrective invoice.
errors.invoiceLifecycle: An invoice has to go through issuing.
errors.draftChanged: Someone changed this draft while you were editing it. Reload and try again.
errors.itemTaken: Some items are no longer pending invoicing.
errors.itemInvoiced: This item has already been invoiced.
errors.lineForeign: A line from another invoice can't be moved here.
errors.futureDate: An invoice can't have a future date.
errors.issuerInactive: The issuer isn't active on the invoice date. Check its registration dates in Settings → Issuers.
errors.verifactuRequired: This issuer is already required to use Verifactu: it has to issue through a certified provider.
errors.totalsMismatch: The totals don't match the lines. Save the draft again.
errors.seriesInvalid: The issuer has no valid series for this type of invoice. Create one in Settings → Issuers.
errors.dateBeforePrevious: The series already has an invoice dated {date}: this one can't have an earlier date.
errors.rectifyInvalid: Only an issued standard invoice can be corrected.
errors.rectificationReasonRequired: Give the reason for the correction.
errors.alreadyRectified: This invoice already has corrective invoices: the next one is issued for the difference.
errors.rectifyingSeriesMissing: The issuer has no corrective series. Create one in Settings → Issuers.
errors.invoiceNotVoided: Items can only be released from a voided invoice.
errors.paymentNotIssued: Payments can only be recorded for issued invoices.
errors.seriesInUse: This series already has invoices issued from GNERAI OS this year: its numbering continues on its own.
errors.lineHasBilling: This line has already been invoiced: instead of deleting it, end it with an end date.
errors.emailNotConfigured: Email sending isn't set up (RESEND_API_KEY or BREVO_API_KEY is missing).
errors.pdfFailed: The PDF couldn't be generated. The invoice is still being issued: try again.
errors.billingRunBusy: A billing run is already in progress for this organization.
errors.providerUnavailable: The invoicing provider didn't respond. The invoice is still being issued: try again.
errors.issuing: Issuing stopped halfway: try again to complete it with the same number.
errors.invoiceNotIssued: Only issued invoices can be sent.
errors.emailCancelled: This email was discarded: prepare a new one if you want to send it.
errors.draftPartyLocked: This draft comes from a contract or corrects another invoice: its issuer and client can't be changed.
